mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repair_crew ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_crew (crew_code, crew_name, skills, shift_type, is_active) VALUES (#{crewCode}, #{crewName}, #{skills}, #{shiftType}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_crew SET crew_name = #{crewName}, skills = #{skills}, shift_type = #{shiftType}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
